coordinates.origin: Single identity-transform root at the horizontal centre of the full animal outline; Z=0 is the lowest filter tip. The animal is swimming, so this is a display mounting datum, not anatomical ground contact.
coordinates.anatomical_layout: Long axis along Y. Pointed head-carapace nose toward -Y, blunt rear toward +Y; left/right are mirrored across X=0. Dorsal flaps attach above ventral flaps. Filters project beneath the head and must remain visible below the shell.
coordinates.export: Blender Z-up, -Y-forward; standard glTF conversion gives Y-up and +Z-forward.

concept.reason: Inspected primary fossil dorsal/lateral views and specimen drawings, the 2015 reconstruction, and the 2023 revised appendage drawing provide sufficient shape evidence. No generated concept is needed; model geometry must be original and must not trace or embed reference art.

scope: Original static refined-low-poly whole-animal reconstruction of Aegirocassis, informed principally by A. benmoulai from the Early Ordovician Lower Fezouata Shale of Morocco. A representative living animal, not a scan, exact individual replica, or claim of resolved soft anatomy.

scientific_limits.en: Body layout and filtering structures are fossil-informed; exact proportions, living colour, pose and soft tissues remain reconstructed. Eyes are inferred from comparative anatomy and oral-cone details are not established for this species. Fine filtering spinules are omitted and visible setae are deliberately reduced and thickened, not a true mesh-size model. The 2023 six-endite interpretation supersedes the five-long-endite layout of the 2015 reconstruction; the terminal appendage region remains incompletely known. No tail fan is added.
scientific_limits.zh: 体态和滤食结构依据化石，精确比例、活体颜色、姿态及软组织仍属复原。眼睛位置来自比较解剖推断，本种口锥细节尚未确定。微细小刺省略，可见刚毛减少并加粗，不代表真实滤网孔径。附肢采用2023年六条长内叶的新解释，不照搬2015年五条长内叶复原；末端节区仍不完整可知。不添加尾扇。

taxon.nomenclature_note: Use benmoulai; corrected by Van Roy, Briggs and Gaines in 2015 and retained by Potin et al. in 2023.

context.interval: Early Ordovician; late Tremadocian reference material
context.locality: Lower Fezouata Shale, Ternata plain near Zagora, Morocco

budget_rationale: Allow the two flap tiers, tripartite shell and open paired filters to remain distinct. Aim for 6500–9500 triangles; spend on silhouette and sparse closed filter bristles rather than microscopic spinules. Caps are practical task budgets, not fossil facts.

dimensions.scale_note: Representative large animal within the reported greater-than-2 m size class, not a measured single individual. Do not unit-normalize.

design.pose: Near-symmetric level swimming and active filtering; mild natural flap cant, no exaggerated attack curl. No stand, substrate, water effects, text or labels in the exported geometry.
design.colour_claim: Entire palette is an original artistic choice; fossil iron staining is not living pigmentation.
design.surface: Controlled facets on large shell/loft forms with clean edge changes; smooth or mixed normals on slender filtering structures. Matte portable PBR materials, no transparency-dependent net sheets.
design.style: Deliberate lofts and shaped fins, not a stack of untouched spheres or cones. Keep large shell, short broad trunk and hanging filter basket readable at thumbnail scale.

morphology_requirements.requirement: Tripartite cephalic carapace: one long pointed, low-convex central shield with an axial keel and rounded broad rear, plus two separate oval lateral elements. Central shield approximately as long as the exposed trunk; it projects forward, not backward over half the trunk. Include modest downturned posterolateral extensions; do not make a helmet dome or bivalve enclosing the animal.

Broad low trunk, slight maximum width near segment 3, then taper to a short blunt segment 11. Preserve 11 discernible segments, with shallow intersegmental recesses. Ten flap-bearing segments; terminal 11th has no added flap pair.

On each of the first ten segments, retain distinct left/right dorsal AND ventral flaps: 20 dorsal plus 20 ventral. Dorsal fins are shorter, pointed and recurved; lower triangular paddles are longer with rounded tips. Separate their root heights and keep successive flaps non-overlapping in neutral pose. They must not read as a single scalloped ribbon.

Indicate transverse bands of setal blades across the back connected near dorsal flap bases, with blades running fore-aft. Simplify as low longitudinal ridges across each dorsal band. Do not mistake these bands for an extra row of fins.

Two frontal appendages beneath the head, each a short articulated upper shaft supporting one shorter proximal comb endite plus six long inward-curved blade-like endites. The first five long endites carry one dense-looking row of thin setae; the sixth has visibly shorter, thicker, curved setae. Preserve a gap and bilateral structure, while inward-canted endites form an open filter basket rather than raptorial claws or six bare rods.

Use representative sparse rows of solid setae with actual air gaps; do not model every biological seta or microspinule and do not claim exact filtering mesh size. Keep first-five versus sixth-endite distinction visible. Distal shaft details are schematic: do not invent a rigidly established extra terminal podomere count.

If included, use two small eyes in posterior gaps between carapace elements, explicitly inferred. Do not add giant anterior eye stalks, a prominent toothed predatory oral cone, walking legs, antennae, a tail fan or tail streamers. A subdued ventral mouth recess may be used only as an acknowledged reconstruction.

visual_acceptance: Front: two separate suspended filtering arrays, open negative space and dorsal/ventral flap height separation; avoid central fused solid grille.
Side: long low forward shield, oval lateral element, hanging curved endites and two distinct flap tiers.
Top: carapace/trunk proportions, 11-part taper, terminal blunt rear without fan, paired rows of separate flaps.
Perspective: all diagnostic features legible together; no accidental collisions, intersecting shell lobes, disconnected bristles or thin-plane disappearance.

views_policy.gray_checks: 3–4 low-cost blockout checks before final polish; private only.
views_policy.preview: May reuse the exact perspective bytes.
views_policy.website_render: No exact website renderer/config has been supplied to this prep. Do not claim website image compliance. Retain standard diagnostic perspective; only generate integration display assets when required by the verified release contract.

frozen_scope: Preparation-only freeze for a local fixed candidate. Maker, technical evidence, independent QA, GPU, scene, user and publication states must each be established separately.
